text: 中国物流与采购联合会公布今年1—8月份物流运行数据。1—8月份，全国社会物流总额243.6万亿元，同比增长4.9%。社会物流总额稳定增长与结构优化同步推进，产业链供应链韧性进一步凸显。具体来看，工业品物流基本盘稳定，1—8月工业品物流总额同比增长5.3%，升级类工业制造物流需求加速。8月高技术制造业、数字产品制造业增加值分别增长16.7%、15.7%，对规上工业增长贡献超六成，工业机器人产量34.6%，共同带动新增物流需求。
text_en: The China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing released logistics operation data for January-August this year. In January-August, the total national social logistics value was 243.6 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year on year. The steady growth of total social logistics value advanced in tandem with structural optimization, further highlighting the resilience of industrial and supply chains. Specifically, the basic plate of industrial goods logistics was stable, with total industrial goods logistics value up 5.3% year on year in January-August, and demand for upgraded industrial manufacturing logistics accelerated. In August, value added in high-tech manufacturing and digital product manufacturing grew 16.7% and 15.7% respectively, contributing more than 60% to above-scale industrial growth, while industrial robot output rose 34.6%, jointly driving new logistics demand.
